result:
I added `migrations/003_exports_status_default.sql`. I haven't run it against a database.

It does three things:
1. Sets `status = 'queued'` on existing rows where it's NULL. `set not null` would fail without this step.
2. Sets the column default to `'queued'`.
3. Sets the column to `NOT NULL`.

I left `001_init.sql` alone. Databases that have already applied it wouldn't pick up an edit, and migrations run in filename order.

Backfilling every NULL row to `'queued'` may be wrong for old jobs that actually finished. If so, change the update before you apply the migration.

I also didn't read `src/exports/sink.ts`. If it inserts an explicit `null` for `status`, that insert will now fail instead of writing a NULL. It should leave `status` out of the insert so the default applies.
